qualifications: Synthetic exchange fills; not trades on an OKX Demo account.

Bounded incident/history/span retention prevents exclusive root-cause claims; JSON normalization is deliberately unchanged.
Host conditions differ from the earlier run; per-window changes are observational, not causal speedup estimates.
Targeted image E2E is not the full E2E/upgrade matrix.
Real Google, GCP KMS/IAM and reviewed managed-Demo cutover remain outside this task.
